_comment: Tracks the full-set examiner pass over BLB (274 cards), goal: every card gets 1-3 examiner/parser-fix iterations, stopping early on a full match or when the remaining gap needs a design decision; non-success cards are left as-is for the user. status: 'match' (full reconstruction confirmed correct -- ALSO added to blb-success.json, which drives app/lib/forgeTranslate.blb.test.ts's snapshot suite) | 'issues-fixed' (a real bug was found+fixed but the card still has an unrelated unfixed gap, so NOT a full match) | 'issues-open' (real gap identified, not fixed -- either narrower than worth a fix pass, or blocked on a bigger schema change) | 'skipped-attempts' (3 examiner loops used, still issues) | 'skipped-rework' (needs a design decision, see note). attempts counts examiner agent runs used (a fix verified by direct node inspection instead of a fresh agent run, to save budget, still counts as using that attempt's slot).
_strategy: Batch 1 (5 cards, full blind examiner each) showed exhaustive per-card examining doesn't scale (~400k+ tokens for 5 cards). Switched to audit-first triage starting batch 2: a static risk-pattern scan (scripts under the job scratch dir, not checked into the repo) flags cards using fragile Forge field shapes; cards hitting only ALREADY-FIXED shared-logic patterns are not re-examined individually (the fix applies uniformly to every card using that pattern); a small diverse spot-check sample is examined per round instead to catch NEW bug classes, and known architectural gaps (see known_gap_classes) are recorded once and applied to every card in that class without spending agent budget on each.

ConditionCheckSVar/ConditionSVarCompare/.description: RESOLVED for Beza's own exact shape (2026-09-04, user design call): ConditionCheckSVar$ X<Metric> compared against ConditionSVarCompare$ <op>Y<Metric> (a real two-player comparison) now produces two `sensor` nodes (your count, opp count, named via SCHEMA's := binding) plus a loose cond:compare= fact on the gated effect -- see svarComparisonFact(). NOT resolved: CheckSVar$ on a static (Essence Channeler's 'as long as you've lost life this turn' -- single-player, not a two-player comparison), and a ConditionCheckSVar$/ConditionSVarCompare$ pair compared against a plain NUMBER instead of a Y-prefixed variable (Harvestrite Host's own EQ2, Cache Grab's own GT0, Mistbreath Elder's own LE0 -- confirmed by spot-checking 4 of the remaining 10 cards, none use Beza's clean X/Y convention) -- svarComparisonFact() deliberately bails out on these rather than fabricating a wrong opponent-side fact. The remaining 10 cards need individual re-checking, not assumed fixed by Beza's resolution. (A narrower, single-object property check on an earlier target -- ConditionDefined$Targeted + ConditionPresent$ Type.powerLEN, or a boolean ConditionPresent$...PromisedGift check -- was already a separate, already-implemented case.) Also confirmed on Bonecache Overseer (AB$ activated-ability variant: CheckSVar$X|SVarCompare$GE3, X folded from two ORed conditions via a Count$.../Plus.Y-with-Times.N-multiplier idiom -- a third attachment point beyond ConditionCheckSVar$ on a downstream effect and CheckSVar$ on a trigger) and Waterspout Warden (CheckSVar$ gating a TRIGGER itself, a plain single-value existence count rather than a comparison -- "if another creature entered this turn") and Bandit's Talent Level 2 (CheckSVar$X|SVarCompare$LE1 gating an activated static trigger). None of these three attachment-point variants are implemented -- only Beza's own downstream two-player X/Y comparison shape is.

Delayed conditional return (DelayedTrigg.description: The real mechanic behind Parting Gust/Salvation Swan's own exile-then-conditionally-return effects: a DelayedTrigger (fires at a future phase) gated by its own ConditionPresent$/ConditionCompare$, returning the object under its OWNER's control (not the caster's) with a counter added. DelayedTrigger's Execute$ child is correctly suppressed now (no longer produces WRONG data), but the mechanic itself has no positive representation -- real, non-trivial modeling work (a delayed-timing dimension on top of the existing gift-condition machinery).

Stat-threshold ValidTgts$ qualifiers (po.description: A target's own printed power/toughness compared to a threshold, written directly into ValidTgts$ (Repel Calamity's own Creature.powerGE4,Creature.toughnessGE4 -- an OR of two stat checks; Sonar Strike's Creature.attacking,Creature.blocking,Creature.tapped is the same OR-of-qualifiers shape but for combat states). qualifierFlags' current design (an array of independently AND'd facts) doesn't cleanly support OR of qualifiers. Distinct from the already-implemented ConditionDefined$Targeted+ConditionPresent$ shape (a condition on an EARLIER target elsewhere in the chain, not the primary ValidTgts$ predicate).

Pawprint$ weighted/repeatable modal choi.description: Forge's Bloomburrow-specific 'choose up to N {P} worth of modes, may repeat' point-buy modal system (Season of the Burrow). SCHEMA's `combine` convention only supports a fixed choose-N-of-the-following shape, not a weighted/repeatable point-buy one. Individual mode effects still translate correctly; only the modal-choice wrapper itself is misrepresented (reads as a plain 'choose one').

Dig's look-then-selectively-reveal-to-ha.description: The current Dig handler only supports 'look at N, move the remainder to a stated DestinationZone$' -- it doesn't read Optional$/ChangeValid$/RestRandomOrder$/DestinationZone$-absent, all needed for Forge's very common 'look at the top N, you may reveal ONE matching card and put it into your hand, put the rest on the bottom in random order' idiom (Star Charter). Worth a real look since this shape recurs across many card types (not BLB-specific).

DB$ Play (cast from an alternate zone, o.description: A whole alternate-casting mechanic ("cast target instant/sorcery from your graveyard without paying its mana cost," Daring Waverider's own) plus its own replacement effect for where the spell goes afterward (ReplaceGraveyard$Exile). Zero handling -- genuinely new, moderately complex effect type, not a quick fix. Wishing Well needs this PLUS two co-requirements to reach full match: DB$ ImmediateTrigger (an SVar-chained "when you do" sub-trigger, falls through to the generic unmapped path with no role:trigger node) and a Count$CardCounters.<Type> scaler (no code path turns it into a role:scaler node) and ReplaceGraveyard$ (an "exile instead of graveyard" replacement effect, never read anywhere in the file).

AlternativeDecider$ (a non-caster player.description: Dire Downdraft's own "target creature's owner puts it on the TOP OR BOTTOM of their library" -- AlternativeDecider$ names WHO makes the choice (here, the target's owner, not the caster), between DestinationAlternative$/LibraryPositionAlternative$-named outcomes. A genuinely new decision-maker/choice concept, entirely unread.

Count$PromisedGift.N.M (dynamic gift-con.description: A narrower cousin of the Condition class above: Dewdrop Cure's own SVar:X:Count$PromisedGift.3.2 means "3 if the gift was promised, else 2" -- swaps a NUMBER rather than gating an effect on/off (which the existing cond:gift_promised/gift_not_promised boolean flags already handle). Also covers the exclusive-or shape (Long River's Pull/Into the Flood Maw/Mind Spiral's own TargetMin$X/TargetMax$X where X = Count$PromisedGift.0.1 or .1.0 -- zeroing out one of two sibling effects depending on gift status, rendered as both happening unconditionally instead). Needs recognizing this specific Count$ shape and binding qty to a declared value via SCHEMA's :=/= label convention. Real modeling work, not a quick fix.

Defined$<sibling-effect-target> self-ref.description: Forge has a whole family of Defined$ values naming 'the object some OTHER effect in this same chain already resolved to' (Targeted, ParentTarget, TriggeredSourceLKICopy, Remembered, DelayTriggerRememberedLKI, ...) -- deriveOwner/coarseType have no general case for any of them, so they fall to defaults (owner:'me', thing:selfThing) that are only coincidentally correct when the referenced object happens to be self-controlled. Mind Spiral's own Defined$ParentTarget (referring to a SIBLING effect's own opponent-controlled target) is a concrete case that resolves wrong. Same broader gap as the already-documented Defined$Targeted entry -- would need threading the parent effect's own resolved owner/thing down into children, a broader signature change.

K:ETBReplacement (enters-as-a-copy / con.description: Forge's ETB replacement-effect keyword family (enters tapped conditionally, enters as a copy of another permanent, etc.) has no handler. Genuinely varied shapes, real feature work.

S:ReduceCost (cost reduction).description: No schema representation for cost reduction at all -- SCHEMA's `cost:` convention is for stating what something costs, not for a rule that lowers a printed cost under a condition. Recurring across several cards; now honestly surfaces as an unmapped S:ReduceCost entry (fixed earlier this session) rather than silently vanishing, but still unimplemented.

TargetsWithDifferentControllers$ (a mult.description: Run Away Together's own "choose two target creatures controlled by DIFFERENT players" -- a real, narrow targeting-restriction concept (relating two targets to each other) with no representation. Distinct from a single target's own qualifiers.

ConditionPresent$ Card.wasCast+!wasCastF.description: Otterball Antics's own "if this spell was cast from anywhere other than your hand" -- a real, narrow dynamic condition (checking THIS spell's own casting zone), distinct from the gift-promised/Threshold conditions already handled.

A:CopySpellAbility (copy target spell).description: Zero handling -- a genuinely new, moderately complex effect type (Kitsa, Otterball Elite's own "copy target instant or sorcery spell you control, may choose new targets"), plus its own self-referential IsPresent$ Card.powerGE3+Self activation-gate on the activated ability's cost (a third IsPresent$/ConditionPresent$ context beyond trigger-level and effect-level).

CopyPermanent (create a token copy of ta.description: DB$ CopyPermanent has no handler at all -- a genuinely new effect type (not a quick field/regex fix), but not big-rework/design-decision-needed either. Real backlog item, not blocking.

ValidSource$SpellAbility.YouCtrl on a Be.description: "Whenever this becomes the target of a spell or ability YOU CONTROL" -- the trigger node's owner field already means "whose occurrence" (self, correctly 'me'), but WHO CONTROLS THE TRIGGERING SOURCE is a different dimension with no home in the current trigger vocabulary. Narrower than the big Condition class -- a real, recurring gap (Flowerfoot Swordmaster, Mouse Trapper, Nettle Guard all hit it) worth a follow-up flag/field addition, not a full redesign.

Pure mana-only activated-ability cost (n.description: The generic activation-cost handler only recognizes a Cost$ containing T (tap) or Sac<> (sacrifice) -- a plain "{3}{W}: effect" cost with neither falls through completely uncosted (Warren Elder's own PumpAll). Would need a parallel cost-node path for the mana-only case.

AddReplacementEffect$ / non-Flying AddKe.description: Fixed this batch -- both now surface honestly as unmapped entries instead of vanishing silently. No node built yet (no schema role for either mechanic), but no longer a silent-drop bug.

S: Full type/ability replacement (SetCol.description: A static that turns a permanent into ONLY a new type (e.g. Sugar Coat's "becomes a colorless Food artifact, loses all other types/abilities, gains a new granted ability") -- a full identity replacement, not a simple AddType/AddKeyword tag. Currently only AddType is read; the rest (SetColor$, RemoveCardTypes$, RemoveAllAbilities$, and the granted AddAbility$ referencing a separate SVar) are silently dropped. A minimal S:TypeReplacement unmapped marker was added for honesty, not a real implementation -- genuinely complex, needs its own node shape.

Multi-clause ValidTgts$/ValidCards$ on a.description: A comma-separated multi-type predicate (e.g. Instant.YouCtrl,Sorcery.YouCtrl) on a targeted non-trigger/non-static effect only reads the first clause, dropping the rest. Triggers and statics already got multi-clause support (specs/affectedSpecs) earlier this session; this is a third, still-unhandled context.

AB$Effect/DB$Effect (Forge's raw generic.description: A whole separate Forge ability API: instead of a typed effect (Pump/Draw/Token/etc), the card uses a generic Effect$ SVar chain driven by raw Execute$/Static-ability scripting bolted onto a placeholder permanent. Zero translator support -- needs its own investigation, likely several distinct sub-shapes rather than one fix.

S:Mode$Continuous (a distinct static sha.description: A static ability line whose Mode$ is Continuous -- a different shape from the already-handled AddPower/AddKeyword/etc static modes, not yet read at all.

PutCounterAll (put counters on all match.description: The plural sibling of PutCounter -- analogous to DestroyAll/DamageAll already implemented for Destroy/DealDamage, but PutCounter's own all-targets variant isn't handled yet. Likely a cheap, well-scoped fix (mirror the DestroyAll/DamageAll pattern).

PeekAndReveal/ChooseCard (multi-step pee.description: A multi-step chain: peek at a zone, then choose a card from among the peeked cards to move/reveal, using PeekAndReveal$/ChooseCard$ SVars with no handler support at any step -- distinct from the simpler Dig look-then-move shape. Whiskervale Forerunner also separately hits the already-documented ValidSource$YouCtrl gap.

Token registry entries carry no keyword-.description: A created token can itself have a printed keyword (Stormchaser's Talent's own Otter token "with prowess", matching TOKEN_SCRIPT_MAP's own ur_1_1_otter_prowess key) but synergy-model/data/registries.json's label entries (labels/stats/subtype only) have no field to carry it, so any granted keyword on a created token is silently lost even though the underlying Forge token-script id literally names it. A real, cheap-looking fix (extend the registry schema with an abilities/keywords field) deferred as a data-schema decision, not attempted.

K:AlternateAdditionalCost (Forage or sim.description: A K: keyword naming a CHOICE of additional cost (Feed the Cycle's own Forage: exile three cards from your graveyard OR sacrifice a Food) falls through translateKeyword()'s bare-keyword/special-case list into the generic unmapped fallback with zero trace -- not even an honest unmapped-only gap, since K: keywords with real mechanical content are expected to produce a node. Needs a real cost-choice node shape plus a registries.json 'forage' action entry.

Chooser$Targeted (a non-caster player se.description: Early Winter's own "target opponent EXILES an enchantment THEY control" -- the targeted PLAYER (not the caster) picks which of their own objects gets affected, via Forge's Chooser$Targeted field. Structurally indistinguishable in the current schema from a normal caster-picks-the-object target (flags:target alone) -- fields.Chooser is never read anywhere in forgeTranslate.ts. A narrower nuance of the broader AlternativeDecider$ non-caster-choice family, not attempted.

Remembered$CardManaCost / other Remember.description: Darkstar Augur's own upkeep trigger ("lose life equal to its mana value") ties a LoseLife$ amount to SVar:X:Remembered$CardManaCost -- the mana value of whatever card was dug/revealed earlier in the SAME chain (RememberChanged$True on the Dig step). No := / = binding connects the Dig node to the LoseLife node's qty; the generic emit builder stamps the literal SVar name "X" onto qty instead of resolving or at least naming the binding. Needs a real scaler-node mechanism analogous to Beza's sensor pair, not attempted.

AB$Effect with nested StaticAbilities$/T.description: Osteomancer Adept's own "{T}: until end of turn, you may cast creature spells from your graveyard by foraging... that creature enters with a finality counter" -- Forge wraps a whole nested ability (a graveyard-cast permission SVar plus a static "if you cast this way" trigger plus a replacement-effect chain granting a counter) inside a single AB$Effect via StaticAbilities$/Triggers$ sub-fields. forgeTranslate.ts emits the tap-cost node but never walks into the nested sub-abilities at all. Also touches the same Forage mechanic as Feed the Cycle's K:AlternateAdditionalCost gap (registries.json has no forage action entry either way) and needs a new flag idiom for granting a named counter type on ETB.

Secondary$True (a same-named ability spl.description: Forge sometimes writes ONE named ability as two T: lines watching different events (LifeGained + LifeLost) with the second marked Secondary$True, meaning they SHARE one activation-limit counter, not two independent ones. Harmless when neither carries an ActivationLimit (Carrot Cake, Wax-Wane Witness -- already matched) but produces a real over-count bug when both carry ActivationLimit$1 (Moonstone Harbinger, allows 2 fires/turn instead of 1). No handling for Secondary$ anywhere in forgeTranslate.ts, and SCHEMA.md has no flag vocabulary for "once per turn, shared across two root trigger nodes" either.

Subtype qualifiers on multi-part predica.description: A predicate like ValidAttackers$ Creature.YouCtrl+Rat correctly derives thing:creature and owner, but the +Rat subtype restriction itself has no fixed vocabulary the way YouCtrl/token/nonLand/etc. do (Forge names hundreds of possible subtypes here) and is silently dropped. A generic "any leftover capitalized qualifier is a subtype" fallback was attempted and reverted after immediately producing a false positive (IsRemembered, a Forge boolean predicate, got mistagged as cond:subtype_isremembered on Starfall Invocation) -- too broad a heuristic for Forge's open-ended qualifier vocabulary. Needs a real allowlist or a different detection strategy, not attempted further.

Builder's Talent.note: See result.json -- ValidCard/ValidCards field-name split and missing .nonCreature qualifier both fixed 2026-09-04, all 3 Class levels now fully match. In blb-success.json.

Crumb and Get It.note: Fixed 2 real gaps 2026-09-04: Pump's KW$ field (a granted keyword, e.g. Indestructible, distinct from a P/T delta) was completely unhandled; ConditionPresent$...PromisedGift is now read as a narrow cond:gift_promised flag (distinct from the general unimplemented ConditionCheckSVar$ class). One precision gap remains open: the indestructible-grant node's `thing` is 'any' instead of 'creature' because Defined$Targeted ("the same creature the earlier Pump targeted") isn't resolved back to the sibling's target type -- would need threading target-type context between chained effects, a broader signature change not done here. Also confirmed the c_a_food_sac registries.json gap (flagged by the exam) is now fixed via this session's token-registry fill-out.

Coruscation Mage.note: See result.json -- .nonCreature qualifier fix (shared with Builder's Talent) plus a new Offspring cond:paid_at_cast marker both fixed 2026-09-04, full match. In blb-success.json.

Beza, the Bounding Spring.note: User made the design call: two sensor nodes (your count, opp count) via SCHEMA's := binding, plus a loose cond:compare= fact -- not fully parametrized, just shows what the card measures. Implemented as svarComparisonFact(), fires only on the exact X<Metric>/Y<Metric> shape (tightened after finding other cards compare against a plain number instead). In blb-success.json.

Banishing Light.note: Attempt 1 missed the .nonLand qualifier and .OppCtrl owner (Forge's Permanent.nonLand+OppCtrl chains qualifiers with + past the first, which the owner/qualifier regexes only matched right after a literal dot). Fixed the regex, plus wired qualifierFlags() into the ChangeZone targeted-move handler (it had .nonLand support added earlier but never actually called). Full 1-ability card now fully matches oracle text -- verified directly against the regenerated packet, not a 3rd live agent run. In blb-success.json.

Brave-Kin Duo.note: Attempt 2 (post Cost$/tap fix) correctly reconstructed the full activated ability except "Activate only as a sorcery" (SorcerySpeed$True had no flag). Added cond:sorcery_speed -- full 1-ability card now fully matches. Verified via forgeTranslate.test.ts, not a 3rd live agent run. In blb-success.json.

Caretaker's Talent.note: Level 3 anthem confirmed correct (AddStaticAbility$ fix from attempt 1 working). Fixed ActivationLimit$1 ("triggers only once each turn") -> cond:once_per_turn. See known_gap_classes.CopyPermanent for the remaining Level 2 gap.

Innkeeper's Talent.note: Spot-check batch 2. Confirmed PutCounter's owner (Creature.YouCtrl) already correct -- examining agent misread it, not a translator bug. Found and fixed a real silent-drop bug: the static handler's unmapped-fallback treated ANY AddKeyword$ value as "handled" (only Flying actually built a node), so AddKeyword$ Ward:1 vanished with zero trace. Fixed via a `handled` tracking flag. Also found AddReplacementEffect$ (a third grant-via-SVar field, distinct from AddTrigger$/AddStaticAbility$) was completely unwired -- fixed in forgeScript.ts, plus fixed a label bug where a missing Mode$ stringified to the literal text 'undefined'. Remaining open: Mode$ Phase's Phase$ field is unread (generic 'phase' trigger-type instead of 'beginning of combat'); Ward/replacement-effect mechanics themselves have no schema role yet (see known_gap_classes).

Eluge, the Shoreless Sea.note: Spot-check batch 2. No new bug class found -- confirms two already-known gaps: CharacteristicDefining$ (dynamic */* P/T, likely a smaller sibling of the sensor-role gap, not full Beza-tier) and a second Mode$ ReduceCost (same shape as Eddymurk Crab's, now at least surfaces honestly post this batch's static-handler fix). The nested SubAbility$->StaticAbilities$ 'remembered object gets a static ability' shape (granting the flooded land its Island type) also isn't followed -- not chased down further.

Eddymurk Crab.note: Spot-check batch 2. Found and fixed a real silent-drop bug: Mode$ ReduceCost (this card's own cost-reduction clause) matched none of the static handler's branches and vanished with no node AND no unmapped entry -- same fix as Innkeeper's Talent's AddKeyword bug (a `handled` flag + honest fallback), now surfaces as S:ReduceCost. Tap-as-effect (this card's own ETB tap-two-creatures) is now implemented (2026-09-04, Mouse Trapper's batch) -- confirmed via regenerated packet, this card's own Tap unmapped entry is gone. Two open gaps remain: S:ReduceCost (cost reduction has no schema representation) and K:ETBReplacement (enters-tapped-conditionally).

Jackdaw Savior.note: Spot-check batch 2. Found and fixed a systemic gap, not card-specific: ChangesZone/ChangesZoneAll with Origin$Battlefield->Destination$Graveyard (rule 700.4 'dies') fell through to the unreadable literal string 'changeszone' -- added an isDies check mirroring the existing isEnter one. Confirmed this also fixed Scavenger's Talent's base trigger in the same batch, so likely benefits several more untested BLB cards using 'whenever ~ dies'. Two narrower, card-specific qualifier gaps left open (multi-clause .YouCtrl/.withFlying, and a Beza-adjacent-but-narrower dynamic mana-value comparison on the return target).

Hop to It.note: Exact match on first attempt. In blb-success.json.

Carrot Cake.note: All facts correct on first attempt; only a structural/presentational difference (2 paragraphs vs. the real card's 1 combined sentence for 2 trigger conditions) -- not a wrong fact, counted as match. In blb-success.json.

Driftgloom Coyote.note: Fixed a real gap: ConditionDefined$Targeted+ConditionPresent$ Type.powerLEN ("if that creature had power 2 or less") had no handling. Added a narrow if_targeted_<stat>_<le|ge>=<N> flag to PutCounter. Full match after fix, verified via regenerated packet. In blb-success.json.

Feather of Flight.note: Fixed a real gap: .EnchantedBy (Aura) wasn't recognized alongside .EquippedBy (Equipment) for the same "attached creature gets X" mechanical fact. Extended the equipped-flag check. Full match after fix. In blb-success.json.

Dawn's Truce.note: Found and fixed a broadly-applicable bug: PumpAll fabricated a fake cond:pt_delta=+0/+0 on every KW$-only grant (no NumAtt$/NumDef$ at all) and had none of Pump's KW$/gift_promised handling -- mirrored Pump's logic exactly. Affects every KW$-only PumpAll card, not just this one. One narrower gap remains open: compound Defined$ "You & Valid Permanent.YouCtrl" (a player AND their permanents in one effect) isn't parsed.

Dewdrop Cure.note: See known_gap_classes['Count$PromisedGift.N.M (dynamic gift-conditional QUANTITY)']. The qty:0..X rendering is working as designed (honest unresolved variable), not a bug -- X's binding just isn't implemented yet.

Essence Channeler.note: Two real gaps: CheckSVar$ conditional static (added to the Condition known_gap_class) and PutCounter's CounterType$EachFromSource passing through as a raw literal instead of a readable value. Neither fixed this round.

Flowerfoot Swordmaster.note: Fixed Valiant$True ("for the first time each turn") by reusing cond:once_per_turn. One narrower gap remains open: ValidSource$SpellAbility.YouCtrl (who controls the triggering spell/ability) has no home in the trigger vocabulary's current owner slot.

Mindwhisker.note: Found and fixed a real, serious bug: S: static handler hardcoded owner:'me' regardless of Affected$'s own qualifiers -- 'creatures your opponents control get -1/-0' wrongly rendered as affecting the caster's own creatures. Fixed by computing owner per Affected$ clause. Also fixed Condition$Threshold. Phase$Upkeep specificity (generic 'phase' trigger-type) remains open.

Mockingbird.note: K:ETBReplacement (enters-as-a-copy mechanic), same known gap class as Eddymurk Crab.

Nightwhorl Hermit.note: Fixed CantBlockBy-with-no-ValidBlocker$ (blanket unblockable) and Condition$Threshold. In blb-success.json.

Otterball Antics.note: Defined$Remembered (new instance of the Defined$<sibling-reference> family) resolves wrong; ConditionPresent$ Card.wasCast+!wasCastFromYourHand (a new, narrow dynamic condition) not represented.

Run Away Together.note: TargetsWithDifferentControllers$True (a real, new targeting-restriction concept) not represented.

Shore Up.note: All facts correct; Untap's Defined$Targeted resolves to an imprecise but not misleading thing value (same family as other Defined$<sibling> gaps), didn't block the correct reconstruction. In blb-success.json.

Into the Flood Maw.note: Count$PromisedGift.N.M dynamic exclusive-or shape, same class as Dewdrop Cure.

Kitnap.note: 4 real bugs found and fixed on this card alone: Mode$Continuous+GainControl$ (zero handling), Defined$Enchanted resolving to a meaningless literal instead of 'creature', PutCounter missing gift-condition handling entirely, and a latent polarity bug in the gift-condition helper (every site hardcoded gift_promised regardless of ConditionCompare$). In blb-success.json.

Kitsa, Otterball Elite.note: A:CopySpellAbility has zero handling -- new complex effect type, plus its own self-referential power>=3 activation gate.

Lightshell Duo.note: Found and fixed a real modeling bug in Surveil: zones were literally backwards, and it collapsed the real 2-node source+emit shape into one invented node. Also fixed the FIN hand-authored ground truth (Namazu Trader), which encoded the same bug. In blb-success.json.

Long River Lurker.note: Found and fixed a real bug: static AddKeyword$ always hardcoded thing:selfThing regardless of Affected$, making a self-Ward and an other-Frogs-Ward grant render identically. Wired into the existing affectedSpecs mechanism. ETB unblockable/blink hits the known ?:Effect gap.

Long River's Pull.note: Benefited from A:Counter. Real card is an exclusive gift-gated either/or, rendered as unconditional both -- same PromisedGift.N.M dynamic-quantity class as Dewdrop Cure.

Mind Spiral.note: Benefited from the gift-condition polarity fix (this card uses EQ1). Defined$ParentTarget owner/thing resolution still wrong (Defined$Targeted-family gap); tap/counter effect's own gift-gating not resolved (PromisedGift.N.M class).

Daring Waverider.note: DB$ Play (cast from an alternate zone without paying cost) has zero handling -- a genuinely new, moderately complex effect type. Not attempted.

Dazzling Denial.note: Implemented A:Counter (zero handling before). Concrete unless-pay dollar amount is a dynamic SVar, captured only as a boolean cond:unless_pay, not the number.

Dire Downdraft.note: S:ReduceCost (known gap) plus a new AlternativeDecider$ shape (a NON-caster player choosing between two outcomes) -- entirely unread, a genuinely new decision-maker concept.

Dour Port-Mage.note: Fixed a real gap: 'leaves the battlefield without dying' (Destination$ = comma list excluding Graveyard) had no trigger-type -- added isLeavesWithoutDying. In blb-success.json.

Finch Formation.note: Fixed a consistency bug: Pump's KW$ Flying used a plain grant=flying instead of the richer blocked_by=flying_or_reach the static handler already had for the same fact -- extracted shared keywordGrantFact() helper. In blb-success.json.

Gossip's Talent.note: Level 1 correct. Level 2 hits the known ?:Effect gap class (granted static on a remembered/targeted object). Level 3 likely hits the Defined$Targeted-family gap.

Starfall Invocation.note: Implemented DestroyAll/DamageAll (had zero handling) and gift_promised on ChangeZone. In blb-success.json.

Thistledown Players.note: Node data was already correct; fixed the packet's own documentation ambiguity around cond:state=tapped/untapped (was readable as a precondition, not the effect). In blb-success.json.

Valley Questcaller.note: Fixed multi-clause Affected$ on static AddPower/AddToughness/AddType (only read the first of 4 comma-joined subtypes before) -- a systemic fix for tribal anthems. In blb-success.json.

Warren Elder.note: A pure mana-cost activated ability (no T, no Sac<>) has no cost handling at all -- same narrower gap noted early this session for Pump, now confirmed hit by a real card. Not fixed.

Warren Warleader.note: Fixed TokenAttacking$True (no handling existed, only TokenTapped$ did). One narrower gap remains: Mode$AttackersDeclared's generic trigger-type.

Wax-Wane Witness.note: Fixed PlayerTurn$True on triggers (reused existing cond:your_turn naming). In blb-success.json.

Whiskervale Forerunner.note: Genuinely complex multi-step effect chain (PeekAndReveal/ChooseCard/conditionally-gated ChangeZone branches) with no handler support at any step -- correctly absent rather than wrong. Left for a dedicated pass. Also hits the ValidSource$YouCtrl gap.

Azure Beastbinder.note: Fixed CantBlockBy (zero handling) and Animate's RemoveAllAbilities$/Power$+Toughness$-only shape (silent-drop, plus Animate always wrongly assumed self-targeting). Primary fact (opponent's permanent loses abilities) now correct. Two narrower gaps remain: 3-way target-type OR not split, and the second Animate node's Defined$Targeted owner/thing still wrong.

Mabel's Mettle.note: Fixed a real gap: Pump had no TargetMax$/TargetMin$ qty handling (unlike ChangeZone/PutCounter's identical convention) -- "up to one other target" read as mandatory. Added qty:0..N support, a systemic fix for every Pump with TargetMax$. TargetUnique$True ("OTHER target") remains open -- deliberately not approximated with not:self, a different and wrong fact.

Mouse Trapper.note: Made the schema call to implement Tap as a standalone effect (DB$/AB$ Tap, distinct from SCHEMA's cost/drain-only `tap` role) -- modeled as modifier+cond:state=tapped/untapped. A systemic fix, not card-specific -- also fixed Eddymurk Crab's own ETB tap effect for free. See known_gap_classes['ValidSource$SpellAbility.YouCtrl on a BecomesTarget trigger'] for the one remaining open gap.

Nettle Guard.note: Fixed a real, systemic bug: Cost$ combining mana+Sac<> (not Sac<> alone) matched no existing detection at all, dropping the entire activated ability. Fixed with a bracket-aware Sac<...> extraction (caught and fixed a regression from the first fix attempt -- Sac<>'s own description clause can contain spaces, breaking a naive space-split) plus coarseType('CARDNAME')->'self'. See known_gap_classes['ValidSource$SpellAbility.YouCtrl on a BecomesTarget trigger'] for the one remaining open gap (on the Valiant trigger, not the fixed sac-cost ability).

Parting Gust.note: Found and fixed a real WRONG-DATA bug (not just a gap): DelayedTrigger's Execute$ child was auto-walked as an unconditional immediate continuation, producing a factually wrong reconstruction (unconditional 'return under your control' instead of the real conditional/delayed/owner's-control/+1-counter return). Fixed by suppressing DelayedTrigger's child-walk specifically. The real delayed+conditional return mechanic itself remains unmodeled (real, non-trivial work) but now correctly absent rather than wrong.

Pileated Provisioner.note: Found and fixed a real gap: PutCounter never called qualifierFlags(ValidTgts$) at all (unlike its siblings) -- .withoutFlying was silently lost. Fixed, plus added .withFlying/.withoutFlying to qualifierFlags' vocabulary. In blb-success.json.

Scavenger's Talent.note: Spot-check batch 2. Benefited from two shared-logic fixes made earlier in this same batch: the dies-trigger fix (base ability) and a new ChangeType$ fix (Level 3's non-targeted 'return a creature card' idiom via ChangeType$ Creature.YouOwn was wrongly read as 'this enchantment returns' -- selfMove's heuristic didn't know about ChangeType$ as a third way Forge names an external subject, alongside ValidTgts$/SacValid$). Fixed by adding ChangeType$ handling to the ChangeZone handler (owner/thing/qualifiers all now derived from it same as ValidTgts$). DB$ Mill (Level 2's effect) is now implemented (2026-09-04, mirrors SCHEMA's own mill-N worked example) -- card now shows zero unmapped entries. One precision gap remains open: WithCountersType$FINALITY on the Level 3 return (a counter placed on the returned object as part of the same effect) has no representation -- narrow, not fixed.

Remaining, deliberately deferred: CheckSVar$/SVarCompare$ hand-size gate on both level-2/3 abilities, and the PlayerCountOpponents$ dynamic draw-count scaler -- both match the known dynamic-condition/scaler classes.

Bonebind Orator.note: Fixed real bug: Cost$ ExileFromGrave<N/CARDNAME> (a graveyard-activated ability's compound cost) had zero handling, silently dropping both the mana AND the self-exile. New wireExileGraveCost() mirrors wireSacCost's Sac<> pattern. Full match on attempt 2.
